# Eke-Abasi Isangifi

> Official portfolio of Eke-Abasi Isangifi, a web developer and digital technologist based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria.

The portfolio describes professional services and selected projects. It is a single-page website; the links below point to sections of that page.

## About
- [About Eke-Abasi Isangifi](https://isangifi.github.io/eke-abasi-isangifi-portfolio--main-/#about): background and approach to practical business technology.

## Services
- [Services](https://isangifi.github.io/eke-abasi-isangifi-portfolio--main-/#services): business websites and e-commerce, business technology and cloud support, digital systems and automation, and digital technology consulting.

## Selected work
- [Portfolio projects](https://isangifi.github.io/eke-abasi-isangifi-portfolio--main-/#work): selected website, e-commerce, and digital operations case studies.
